How to Cycle It

Frequency

3 sessions per week (e.g. Mon / Wed / Fri), rotating A → B → C → A. Rest at least one day between sessions to let muscles recover.

Progression

Start light and focus on form. Add weight only once you can complete the top of the rep range with good technique on every set.

Recovery

Sleep 7–9 hours, stay hydrated, and don't skip rest days — recovery is when your body actually adapts and gets stronger.

Warm Up / Cool Down

5 minutes of light cardio and dynamic stretching before, 5–15 minutes of mobility or easy cardio after every session.

Don't Forget Aerobic Activity

This plan covers strength. Separately, aim for 150 minutes/week of moderate cardio (brisk walking, cycling, swimming) or 75 minutes/week of vigorous cardio — the Day C finisher alone won't cover it. A daily walk is the easiest way to close the gap.

Full Body Workout Regimen — cycle Day A → B → C → Rest, repeat.
